The Prophet had the palms of Bani An-Nadir burnt and cut down at Al-Buwaira, as a poem of Hassan bin Thabit recalls.
The Prophet burnt the date-palms of Bani An-Nadir.
Asma carried date stones from land the Prophet gave Az-Zubair, land taken from the property of Bani An-Nadir.
Both tribes fight; Bani An-Nadir are exiled; when Bani Quraiza fight again their men are killed, their women, children and property shared out; al-Hashr is Surat an-Nadir; An-Nadir's palms burnt.
Ibn Abbas says Surat al-Hashr, or Surat an-Nadir, concerned Bani an-Nadir, and a verse says the Prophet's burning and cutting down of their palm trees was by Allah's leave.
